svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Band-pass filter frequency response: centre frequency, bandwidth and Q
svg.desc: Gain in decibels against frequency on a log scale, for band-pass filters centred on 1 kHz with Q = 1. The two -3 dB points are at 618 Hz and 1618 Hz, so the bandwidth is 1000 Hz and the centre frequency is their geometric mean, 1 kHz. The second-order filter falls at 20 dB per decade on each side; the fourth-order filter falls at 40 dB per decade on each side. Below fL and above fH are the lower and upper stopbands.
